text:
Glad it's done. Take a break, that was a lot of cleanup.

One correction to my earlier walkthrough: I said Maya's row 1 would be marked `SUPERSEDED`, but that's wrong. The Flag C formula only marks a row when another row with the same email has a *later* timestamp. Her two rows have identical timestamps, so neither gets flagged, and both could end up in your final set. If you have exact ties like that, replace column O with this version, which breaks ties by keeping the lower row:

```
=IF(K2="","",IF(COUNTIFS($K$2:$K$421,K2,$I$2:$I$421,">"&I2)+COUNTIFS(K3:K$422,K2,I3:I$422,I2)>0,"SUPERSEDED",""))
```

When you're back, a quick filter on column M for `DUP-email` will show whether any pairs slipped through.
